dep.panel.externalLock: Detected a lock file managed by {mgr} — Pylume manages dependencies with uv; the declaration-layer detection of this project is degraded (only missing-import detection is effective). Migrating to uv is recommended.
dep.panel.fileClean: ✓ No file-level dependency issues (missing imports / undeclared dependencies)
dep.panel.guideDisabled: Its lock file format is not parsed — the declaration-layer detection (E2–E5) is disabled proactively instead of producing wrong results; only environment availability (E1 missing imports) is effective.
dep.panel.guideHead: Pylume manages dependencies with uv (consistency checking / one-click fixes). This project is detected as managed by {mgr},
dep.panel.guideStep1: 1. Export the dependency list with the original tool (e.g. poetry export -f requirements.txt -o requirements.txt)
dep.panel.guideStep2: 2. Run uv add -r requirements.txt in the project root (generates pyproject.toml + uv.lock)
dep.panel.guideStep3: 3. After verifying the environment is correct, delete the old lock file (e.g. poetry.lock) — otherwise the project is still identified as managed by {mgr}
dep.panel.guideSteps: Migration steps (run in a terminal; Pylume does not modify declaration files):

dep.panel.migrateGuideTitle: Declaration-layer detection degraded · migrate to uv
